summary: This background figure illustrates sequence parallelism (an extension of Striped Attention) as used in the prefill phase, which LoongServe's elastic sequence parallelism builds on. The input token sequence is permuted once and split into segments dispatched to three parallel instances. Within each repeated transformer layer, every instance computes a local Projection to get query and key-value tensors, then at the Attention step it both computes attention locally and exchanges key-value tensors with its neighboring instance in a ring pattern over multiple rounds, before passing output to Local Layers. The diagram uses three horizontal instance lanes separated by dashed lines, colorful flat-filled boxes for each stage, and color-coded curved arrows to show the cross-instance key-value exchange, contrasting the one-time initialization/permutation step on the left with the repeated per-layer computation on the right.
summary_zh: 该图展示前填充阶段的序列并行（源自Striped Attention）：输入序列经一次置换后被拆分给三个并行实例；每层中各实例先做本地投影得到query/kv，再在注意力层与相邻实例交换kv张量并计算注意力，最后进入本地层。图中以三条实例泳道和彩色箭头表示跨实例kv交换。
